definitions: The state of being no longer needed or useful.
The act of making an employee redundant.
The use of more words than are necessary to express a meaning, either intentionally or unintentionally.
The inclusion of extra components which are not strictly necessary but which can be used to provide a backup in the event of a failure.
examples: The company announced a wave of redundancies.
There is a lot of redundancy in his writing.
They faced redundancy after the factory closed.
